subject.summary: A bought Waveshare HexArth hexapod carrying a printed carapace and a 12 cm pothos pot: it walks a few slow steps to follow the sun and sits the rest of the day. Robot sizes from Waveshare's drawing; carapace, pot cradle and sensor dome are a new design; the plant is decoration.

dock pad with two spring contacts under the belly

a printed shell that bolts to the top plate, hides the Pi and cells and cradles the pot
a light 12 cm plastic pot, not terracotta
